jobs.title: Designer Outlet
jobs.description:
The Designer will be responsible for researching and interpreting emerging fashion and consumer trends, translating them into commercial products that reflect the Factory Outlet brand identity and meet customer expectations. By identifying new product opportunities and developing commercially relevant collections, the designer will play a key role in driving the evolution of the assortment while collaborating closely with Merchandising and Buying, and Product Development teams. According to their level of expertise, the designer will independently manage advanced design activities and contribute to strategic product decisions.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

## Requirements
- Bachelor Degree or Diploma in Fashion and/or Design Arts.
- At least 3-4 years of experience in the same role and field.
- Strong knowledge of fashion and emerging trends.
- Strong attitude and understanding of fashion product, style, and graphic trends.
- Creative, with a clear understanding of the brand DNA, and a very pragmatical approach.
- Fashion eye with commercial awareness.
- Ability to handle multiple tasks/projects with adherence to deadlines and design calendar.
- Dynamic personality, fast thinker, positive attitude.
- Availability for traveling if needed.
- Sense of urgency and flexibility
- Fluent English.
- Good knowledge of computer skills: Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
- Extensive experience with Adobe CS software, including Illustrator and Photoshop
- 3D design skills preferred (Clo 3D).

## Benefits
- Balance between work and personal life: Smart Working (Hybrid work model) and Time flexibility
- An International, fresh and dynamic working environment
- Physical & Mental Health programs, sustainable projects and workshop promoted by Guess Community
- Arts, sports and social events outside the office, thanks to our Guess Fun activities!
- Training & Development platform and paths
- Discount on our products both online and in stores

In base al proprio livello di competenza, il progettista gestirà autonomamente le attività di progettazione avanzata e contribuirà alle decisioni strategiche di prodotto.

- Forte conoscenza della moda e delle tendenze emergenti.
- Forte attitudine e comprensione del prodotto di moda, dello stile e delle tendenze grafiche.

- Disponibilità a viaggiare se necessario.

- Buona conoscenza delle competenze informatiche: Excel, Word, Outlook e PowerPoint.
- Vasta esperienza con il software Adobe CS, tra cui Illustrator e Photoshop

jobs.title: E-Commerce Performance and SEO Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Reporting directly to the Chief Digital Officer, the E-Commerce Performance Marketing & SEO Senior Manager, is responsible for creating and implementing online marketing strategies to drive traffic to the site, that bring sales and revenue for Guess e-commerce website. He/she will be responsible for driving qualified traffic, customer acquisition, revenue growth, and online visibility through paid and organic digital channels.

Another task will be the supervision of the entire Performance Marketing team and all the activities performed by it.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

SEO Responsibilities

Together with the SEO lead on his/her team and the support of an external agency, we aim to:

## Requirements
- At least 12 years’ experience in web-marketing and CRO environment
- At least 8 years’ experience in SEO and analytics Tools as Google Analytics, Google Trends, SEM Rush, Adobe Omniture and Google Search Console tool
- Excellent knowledge of Office package, especially Excel
- HTML good knowledge
- Proficiency knowledge of English language (both written and spoken). Any additional language is a plus
- Must possess strong leadership skills and be precise, well organized, self-motivated, focused on meeting deadlines and able to multitask within a fast-paced environment
- Attention to detail and follow-up
- Excellent analytical and time management skills. Preference to work with number
- Excellent execution, high respect of deadlines and good level of proactivity
- Sense of ownership and pride in the performance and its impact on company’s success
- Capability of adapt to changes and work under pressure
- Critical thinker and problem-solving skills
- Capability to work under strict, short deadlines
- Positive attitude, team player, ability to work independently and to coordinate projects and people.
- Lead, mentor and support the other team members.
- Demonstrates strong decision-making ability
- Ability to drive & apply continuous improvement in process and tools
- Ability to establish and maintain harmonious working relationships with co-workers, staff and external contacts, and to work effectively in a professional team environment
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact with a diverse group at all level
- Interested to work in an international environment and to network with worldwide business units

## Benefits
- An International, fresh and dynamic working environment
- Balance between work and personal life: Smart Working (Hybrid work model) and Time flexibility;
- Physical & Mental Health programs, sustainable projects and workshop promoted by Guess Community
- Arts, sports and social events outside the office, thanks to our Guess Fun activities!
- Training & Development platform and paths
- Discount on our products both online and in stores

- Pensatore critico e capacità di problem solving
- Capacità di lavorare sotto scadenze rigorose e brevi
- atteggiamento positivo, giocatore di squadra, capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e coordinare progetti e persone.
- Guida, mentore e sostenere gli altri membri del team.
- Dimostra una forte capacità decisionale

- Un ambiente di lavoro internazionale, fresco e dinamico
- Equilibrio tra lavoro e vita personale: Smart Working (modello di lavoro Hybrid) e flessibilità del tempo;
- Programmi di salute fisica e mentale, progetti sostenibili e workshop promossi da Guess Community

jobs.title: Visual Merchandising Director
jobs.description:
Responsible for creating developing and executing the true to life, in store visual representation of our brand. This position will coordinate with the merchant, creative services, planning, operations and retail development to conceptualize, establish and deliver visual merchandising guidelines for both retail stores and wholesale accounts, designed to meet the sales and profitability goals

The Visual Merchandising Director is responsible for articulating and executing creative vision, visual window concepts and installations for boutiques and showrooms ensuring a stimulating environment that enhances the customer store experience and promotes brand consistency.

Creates functional strategies and specific objectives for the sub-function and develops budgets/policies/procedures to support the functional infrastructure.

The role is in charge of supervising the team in upholding VM standards, guidelines as well as developing local relevant strategies in all locations (retail, partner stores and wholesale partners) across the global market through overseeing all VM initiatives related to existing store needs, campaign launches, special events and new store openings.
